test_code.description: Complete Python unittest source with actual newline characters. Do not wrap the entire test module in exec/eval of an encoded string: test attribution must retain real source locations. The test file is outside the project; locate the real repository from cwd, not from the test file __file__.

test_driver.description: Complete revised driver. [] reuses the current driver unless a test_driver correction explicitly sets [].

evidence.description: Required for every frozen acceptance revision; before first freeze use []. Provide valid original evidence with exact quotes, including whitespace. Original requirements, confirmed delivery constraints and user-fixed commands are protected. Matching proves provenance, not semantics.

source.description: task_request, user_update:<persisted human update id>, or original_file:<task-start frozen relative path>. Never current outputs, generated files, URLs or edited workspace contents.

quote.description: Exact original quotation, without trimming, ellipses or corrections.

corrections.description: Required after freezing; before first freeze use []. Declare every change against the active FROZEN materials, even when revising a pending proposal. Tests, fixtures, inputs, assertions, cases, drivers, execution checks and model-generated regression commands may change with cited evidence. Preserve original requirements and confirmed delivery constraints. Text replacements must not overlap and must produce exactly the complete submitted field.

before.description: For text fields: one exact unique old snippet, including unchanged context if needed. For test_driver/execution_checks: the complete old array encoded as JSON text.

after.description: Replacement text or the complete new array encoded as JSON text. Empty text permits deletion; empty before is allowed only when the complete old text field is empty.

reason.description: Explain why the cited original evidence supports this change without changing the original requirement. A quotation alone does not establish semantic correctness.

requirement_quote.description: Verbatim original requirement scope; empty binds the complete original request.

requirement_id.description: ID of the confirmed original delivery target; empty only when there is exactly one target.

python_module.description: Optional dotted module for Python -m; entry_file must be its module .py or package __main__.py. Empty executes the original file.

api_entry.description: For python_api only: the original module:function or module:Class.method actually called by the bound unittest methods.

test_ids.description: For python_tests only: Class.test_method IDs in test_code. Each must actually call the API or read the original artifact through acceptance_artifacts.read_artifact(relative_path). No second execution is performed.

execution_checks.description: Complete revised execution declarations, still bound to every confirmed original target. [] reuses current declarations unless explicitly corrected; required execution cannot be removed.

regression_command.description: Complete revised model-generated regression command; empty reuses the current command unless a regression_command correction explicitly clears it. Never change a user-fixed command.
